cases.title: Schooling in open water

semanticResult.evidence: The image shows a large, uniform blue expanse with no visible substrate or structural features like rocks, coral, or seagrass. The fish are swimming freely in a homogeneous medium, characteristic of open water. The black masked region is foreground removal and does not represent the background.
semanticResult.ecological_hint: In high fish-density areas, open water often supports schooling behavior and provides ample space for movement, contrasting with structured habitats like coral reefs or seagrass beds which typically have more defined boundaries and substrate.

cases.title: Aggregation near coral
